You resist cold damage and can talk to creatures that breathe water.
When you or a creature you can see within 10 feet of the tentacle takes damage, reduce it by 1d8 (2d8 at level 10).
Cast Evard’s black tentacles once per long rest without a slot or concentration. You gain temp HP when you cast it.
Teleport yourself and up to five willing creatures up to 1 mile to water you have seen. Once per long rest.
Gain a magical vessel that can serve as a rest space. Use it to deal extra damage equal to your proficiency bonus of a type tied to your patron once per turn.
You gain resistance to a damage type tied to your genie, and can fly for 10 minutes. Uses equal your proficiency bonus per long rest.
Pull up to five creatures into your vessel for hours. They gain extra healing on a long rest and temp HP.
Cast a spell of 6th level or lower using the genie’s power, without needing its material parts. Once per long rest after 1d4 days.
Your magical quill copies spells faster and cheaper, and makes ink in seconds. It can write nonmagical text instantly.
You can cast ritual spells quickly as an action. When you cast a spell from your spellbook, swap its damage type to another it knows and treat it as a different spell for one cast.
Conjure a spectral mind within 60 feet as a bonus action. Cast spells from its position and sense through it for 1 hour. Once per long rest or spend a slot.
At the end of a long rest, make a scroll of a spell you know of level 1 or 2 using a slot. You can cast it as a bonus action later.
When you take damage, you can instead lose spell knowledge in your book to prevent it. Once per long rest.

Needs dragonborn. +1 STR, CON or CHA. Replace your breath weapon with a roar: creatures within 30 feet make a WIS save or become frightened for a minute.
Needs dragonborn. +1 STR, CON or CHA. You grow retractable claws that deal 1d4 slashing, and your unarmored AC becomes 13 plus your DEX modifier.
Needs drow. Cast detect magic at will. Cast levitate and dispel magic once each per long rest. Charisma is your spellcasting ability for these.
Needs high elf. +1 INT or CHA. Learn Sylvan and cast misty step once per short or long rest.
Needs tiefling. +1 INT or CHA. Reroll 1s on fire damage dice, and when you cast a fire spell, flames wreathe you and deal 1d4 fire damage to attackers.
Needs tiefling. +1 CON. You resist cold and poison damage and have advantage on saves against being poisoned.
Needs half-orc. +1 STR or CON. Once per short or long rest, add one extra weapon damage die on a hit, and use your reaction to strike after Relentless Endurance triggers.
Needs half-elf, half-orc or human. Gain one skill proficiency, one tool proficiency and one language of your choice, plus expertise in one skill you are proficient in.
Needs halfling. +1 DEX, CON or CHA. When a creature hits you, use your reaction to force a reroll of the attack. Once per short or long rest.
Needs dwarf or Small race. +1 STR or DEX. Speed rises by 5 feet, you gain a skill proficiency in Acrobatics or Athletics, and have advantage on grapple escapes.
Needs elf or half-elf. Learn one druid cantrip, and cast longstrider and pass without trace once each per long rest without slots. Wisdom is your spellcasting ability.

name: Eldritch Invocation: Aspect of the Moon

summary.effect: Needs Pact of the Tome. You no longer need to sleep and cannot be forced to sleep by magic. You can use the time of a long rest to read or do light activity.
Needs level 5 and Pact of the Chain. A bonus action wraps you in buzzing flies for a minute. Nearby foes take poison damage each turn.
Needs level 5 and Pact of the Blade. When you hit with your pact weapon, spend a pact slot to add force damage and knock the target prone.
Needs level 7. As an action, gain the ability to see through solid objects within 30 feet until the end of your next turn.

name: Eldritch Invocation: Gift of the Depths

summary.effect: Needs level 5. You breathe water and gain a swim speed equal to your walk speed. Cast water breathing once per long rest without a slot.

name: Eldritch Invocation: Gift of the Everliving Ones

summary.effect: Needs Pact of the Chain. While your familiar is within 100 feet, healing you receive from dice uses the maximum roll.
Needs eldritch blast. Once per turn when your eldritch blast hits, pull the creature up to 10 feet straight toward you.
Needs Pact of the Blade. Your pact weapon can be a shortbow, longbow, light or heavy crossbow, adds to your attack and damage rolls, and doubles as a spellcasting focus.
Needs eldritch blast. Once per turn when your eldritch blast hits, cut the creature’s speed by 10 feet until the end of your next turn.
Needs level 5 and the hex spell. As a bonus action, deal psychic damage equal to your CHA modifier to creatures within 5 feet of your hexed target.
Needs level 7. As a bonus action, teleport next to a creature you cursed, up to 30 feet away, as long as you can see it.
Needs level 15. You can cast invisibility at will without a slot.
Needs level 5. Reaction after taking damage: gain 10 temp HP per warlock level, vulnerability to fire, and freeze with speed 0 until your next turn ends. Once per short rest.
Needs level 7. Cast freedom of movement once per long rest without a slot.
While raging, the first creature you hit each turn has disadvantage on attacks against others, and those others resist its damage until your next turn.
While raging, when an ally within 30 feet takes damage, reduce it by 2d6. The die grows at levels 10 and 14.
Cast augury or clairvoyance without a slot, using Wisdom. Once per short or long rest.
When Spirit Shield reduces damage, the attacker takes force damage equal to the amount prevented.
When you rage, pick desert, sea or tundra. A 10-foot aura deals damage, shocks foes or grants temp HP to allies, and renews each turn you rage.
Gain a lasting boon from your chosen environment, such as fire resistance, cold resistance or free water breathing and movement.
Allies in your aura share your resistance from Storm Soul.
Your aura gains a strong effect: lightning on a hit, a tidal slam that knocks prone, or frozen ground. It uses your STR for the save.
On your first hit each turn while raging, deal extra radiant or necrotic damage of 1d6 plus half your barbarian level.
A spell that raises you from the dead needs no material component.
Once per rage, reroll a failed saving throw and take the new result.
Up to ten allies within 60 feet gain advantage on attacks and saves until your next turn. Once per long rest, or by spending a slot.
While raging, you stay conscious at 0 hit points and die only when the rage ends with you still at 0.
Spend a Bardic Inspiration die to give allies temp HP and let them move without opportunity attacks.
After a minute performing, charm creatures that watch. They stay friendly for an hour or so.
For a minute, you can cast command each turn at no cost and appear in a beautiful fey guise.
Take a regal form for a minute. Creatures that target you with an attack or harmful spell must save or lose that action.
Gain Dueling or Two-Weapon Fighting. You can use a melee weapon as a spell focus.
Your Attack action grants you speed, and once per turn you can spend an inspiration die for a flourish that adds damage or other effects.
You can attack twice when you take the Attack action.
When you use a flourish, roll a d6 instead of spending an inspiration die.
When you hit with a weapon, spend a Bardic Inspiration die for extra psychic damage, once per turn.
After talking one minute with a creature, it makes a WIS save or is frightened of a chosen creature for an hour.
When a humanoid dies near you, capture its shadow and take on its appearance for an hour.
Whisper to a creature that fails a WIS save. It acts as your friend and obeys unless in danger.
Gain heavy armour and smith’s tools proficiency.
At the end of a long rest, make a weapon or armour +1 for that day.
Spend an hour working to create a simple metal item worth up to 100 gp in value.
Gain +1 AC in heavy armour and resistance to fire.
Once per turn, a weapon hit deals extra fire damage: 1d8, then 2d8 at level 14.
Gain immunity to fire and resistance to nonmagical physical damage while wearing heavy armour.
Healing spells always roll maximum on a creature at 0 hit points, and you learn spare the dying as a bonus action.
Sense undead within 60 feet for a turn. Uses equal your WIS modifier per long rest.

name: Channel Divinity: Path to the Grave

summary.effect: A creature you see is cursed until your next turn and takes double damage from the next attack against it.
When a critical hit is made near you, turn it into a normal hit. Uses equal your WIS modifier per long rest.
Add your Wisdom modifier to cleric cantrip damage.
When an enemy dies within 60 feet, you or an ally nearby regains hit points equal to its hit dice, once per turn.
Gain proficiency in Arcana or Nature, and learn prestidigitation or druidcraft.
Choose two magical shot options. Once per turn on a hit, use one to add damage and a rider effect. Twice per short rest.
Arrows from your bow count as magical.
Redirect a missed magic shot at a different target within 60 feet.
If you start initiative with no Arcane Shot uses, regain one.
Gain advantage on weapon attacks until the end of your turn and temp HP. Three uses per long rest.
Gain proficiency in one skill, or in a language of your choice.
Add your WIS to Persuasion checks and gain WIS save proficiency.
When you roll initiative with no uses left, regain one Fighting Spirit use.
Give up advantage on an attack to make one extra attack as part of the same action.
When you drop to 0, take an extra turn before falling unconscious. Once per long rest.
Gain Performance proficiency and brewer’s supplies.
When you use Flurry of Blows, you also take the Disengage action and gain extra speed.
Stand from prone for little movement, and redirect a missed melee attack to another creature, spending ki.
Spend ki to cancel disadvantage on a roll.
Flurry of Blows can make up to five attacks against different targets.
Pick two kinds of weapon to count as monk weapons. You gain an agile parry and weapon-based abilities with them.
Your chosen weapons count as magical, and you can add damage by spending ki.
Spend up to 3 ki to give a weapon a bonus to attack and damage for a minute.
Once per turn, reroll a missed monk weapon attack.
Make a ranged spell attack within 30 feet for radiant damage, using a monk weapon rolls. Spend ki to make extra bolts.
After the Attack action, spend ki to cast burning hands as a bonus action.
Create a burst of radiant light, 20 feet in radius, within 150 feet. Spend ki to increase damage.
Shed bright light and deal radiant damage in reaction to melee hits against you.
Creatures of your choice within 30 feet make a WIS save or are frightened of you for a minute.
Add +10 to an attack roll you make, after seeing the die.
Frightened creatures within your aura have speed 0 and take psychic damage equal to half your paladin level at turn start.
Creatures that hit you take psychic damage equal to your CHA modifier.
For a minute, resist all damage, add an extra attack, and crit on 19 or 20. Once per long rest.
Gain +5 to Persuasion checks for ten minutes.
When a creature deals damage to another within 30 feet, it takes radiant damage equal to what it dealt, with a WIS save for half.
When a creature within 10 feet takes damage, you take it instead. Damage cannot be reduced in any way.
At the end of each turn with half HP or less, regain 1d6 plus half your paladin level in HP.
Resist all damage from other creatures, and reflect half of it back. It ends if you attack or harm.
Sense the direction of the nearest planar portal within a mile. Once per short or long rest.
Choose a creature within 30 feet. The next hit this turn deals extra force damage and counts as force.
Step into the Ethereal Plane until the end of your turn, as the etherealness spell does, with no slot. Once per short or long rest.
When you take the Attack action, teleport 10 feet before each attack. If you hit two targets, gain a bonus attack.
When you take damage, gain resistance to it.
Learn if a creature has immunities, resistances or vulnerabilities. Uses equal your WIS modifier per long rest.
Mark a creature. The first hit each turn on it deals an extra 1d6 damage.
Add 1d6 to saves against the prey’s effects and grapple escapes.
When a creature casts a spell or teleports, force a WIS save or it fails.
When your prey forces a save, make a weapon attack before the save. If it hits, you succeed.
Treat any Insight roll under 8 as 8 when someone is lying.
Use a bonus action to make a Perception check or Investigation check.
Contest Insight against a creature’s Deception. If you win, use Sneak Attack on it without advantage for a minute.
Have advantage on Perception or Investigation if you move no more than half your speed.
Sense illusions, shapechangers and other deceptions within 30 feet. Uses equal your WIS modifier per long rest.
While Insightful Fighting is active, Sneak Attack damage increases by 3d6.
Gain disguise and forgery kits, one game set, two languages, and mimic speech after hearing it.
Take the Help action as a bonus action, from 30 feet away.
After observing a creature for a minute, learn if it is stronger or weaker than you in certain stats.
When a creature attacks you with an ally in the way, redirect the attack to that ally.
Your thoughts cannot be read, and you can lie without magic exposing it.
When an enemy ends its turn within 5 feet, move half your speed without provoking.
Gain Nature and Survival proficiency and double your bonus in both.
Your walking speed rises by 10 feet, and your climb and swim speeds also rise.
Gain advantage on initiative, and the first creature you hit in round one is easier to hit for your allies.
Make an extra attack as a bonus action, and apply Sneak Attack to it even if you already used it.
A creature you attack in melee cannot make opportunity attacks against you that turn.
Add your CHA modifier to initiative, and use Sneak Attack when alone with a foe, without advantage.
Make a Persuasion check against a creature’s Insight. Charm a hostile or taunt a foe into attacking only you.
Gain advantage on your next Acrobatics or Athletics check.
When you miss with an attack roll, reroll with advantage once per short rest.
You can learn cleric spells as sorcerer spells, and gain a bonus spell based on your alignment.
When you fail a save or miss an attack, add 2d4. Once per short or long rest.
When you or an ally rolls healing dice from your spell, spend a sorcery point to reroll them.
Sprout wings and gain a fly speed of 30 feet.
When below half HP, regain half your maximum hit points. Once per long rest.
Gain darkvision to 120 feet, and learn darkness for 2 sorcery points, which you can see through.
When damage would drop you to 0, make a CHA save to stay at 1 hit point. Once per long rest.
Spend 3 sorcery points to call a shadow hound that hunts a target within 120 feet.
In dim light or darkness, teleport up to 120 feet to another dim space.
Spend 6 sorcery points to become a shadow for a minute, resisting most damage.
You can speak, read and write Primordial and its dialects.
After casting a spell of level 1+, fly 10 feet without opportunity attacks.
Gain lightning and thunder resistance. Damage spells of those types hurt nearby creatures with half your level.
Stop rain around you or redirect the wind for a minute, as you choose.
When hit by a melee attack, deal lightning damage equal to your sorcerer level, and push it.
Gain a fly speed of 60 feet and immunity to lightning and thunder. You can share it with allies.
Learn light and sacred flame.
Keep a pool of d6s equal to 1 + your warlock level, refilled on a long rest. Spend them to heal a creature within 60 feet. Track the pool by hand.
Gain radiant resistance. When a spell deals radiant or fire damage, add your CHA modifier to one target.
Gain temp HP after a rest, for you and allies equal to your level plus CHA.
When you make a death save, release a burst of radiant light, healing you and blinding foes. Once per long rest.
Curse a creature for a minute: extra damage equal to your proficiency, crit on 19–20, and healing on kill. Once per short or long rest.
Gain medium armour, shields and martial weapon proficiency, and use CHA for one weapon’s attack and damage.
When you slay a humanoid, raise its spirit as a specter that serves you until the end of your next long rest.
When the cursed target hits you, roll a d6. On a 4 or higher, the attack misses.
When your cursed target dies, move the curse to a new creature within 30 feet without using a rest.
